before: Native Return from Add playlist name makes the focused input disabled and leaves BODY during the create and list invalidation. Success restores Actions for Song10000 normally; that existing completion behavior is preserved.
implementation: Read-only name and native-focusable aria-disabled select/checkbox preserve focus. Block key/pointer/click native changes while pending or uncertain and restore controlled values in onChange. Tab and Escape retain their normal guarded routing.

Synchronous inFlight blocks duplicate submit, dismissal and Review playlists through async success/error invalidations. onSettled unlocks. Definite rejection keeps the draft; uncertain results cannot repeat a write.
Save remains native-focusable during pending/uncertain states, including when refreshed recovery metadata changes. Existing business eligibility gates remain for settled forms.

Optional Shared Dialog closeDisabled gives a visible aria-disabled Close icon and guards icon/Escape/backdrop. The existing playlist-name dialog also opts in during save. Scoped muted/progress styling keeps values and focus outlines readable.

pairedDecision.Steve: Initially proposed guarded aria-disabled native controls. Challenge preferred native-disabled select/checkbox with synchronous transfer to Save, reserving concern about popup ambiguity. Actual source review supports implemented guards subject to native/assistive-technology confirmation.
pairedDecision.Elena: Proposed preserving focus with native default prevention and controlled restoration; supported optional Shared close presentation. Actual source review found missing visual unavailable treatment for select/checkbox/Review; root added scoped styles.
pairedDecision.Morgan: Chose focus preservation provisionally over submit-time focus transfer, then native-tested both select and checkbox. Down/Space/Return/pointer leave the select closed/unchanged; Space/pointer leave checkbox unchanged. Both keep native focus. No new AT/VoiceOver pass.
pairedDecision.finalReview: Steve and Elena independently reviewed final source, four matching source hashes and the evidence record; both found no blocker. VoiceOver/AT and Q06 limits retained.

sourceTraceSupplement.text: - During an add operation, choose an existing playlist or create a new one. Keep the chosen destination, name and skip-existing option readable and keyboard-focusable while saving, with edits locked. Show unavailable Save, Cancel, Close and Review actions; repeated activation cannot duplicate the write or leave during its readback. A definite failure retains the draft for an explicit retry. An uncertain result locks changes and offers checking the refreshed playlists. Success closes the dialog and restores its opener.

| M6 | I can edit playlists without repeating uncertain changes | My account may edit a shared playlist, or a save loses its response | Attempt the allowed action; inspect refreshed order after an uncertain result | Adding songs keeps destination, name and skip-existing values readable and focusable through save/readback, locks changes and visibly guards Save/Cancel/Close/Review against duplicate writes or navigation, retains definite-failure drafts for explicit retry, and closes on success with opener focus; Creating or renaming keeps the name readable and focus within the pending dialog; repeated save/dismiss keys cannot repeat the change; confirmed creation opens its detail on Back while the modal still owns interaction, including internal Tab movement; outside actions, overlays or backgrounding cancel that focus handoff; definite rejection retains the editable draft after readback, uncertain saves stay locked, and rename/cancel restore their opener; Jellyfin authorizes unknown permissions, explicit read-only stays disabled, unconfirmed permission never claims read-only or hides otherwise readable tracks, auth/account or playlist-data failures still surface, errors remain visible, and an uncertain reorder/removal needs successful refresh plus acknowledgement before editing continues; pending/error/review state survives page changes, playlist switches, library saves and same-account sign-in; after restart an unresolved addition/reorder/removal still needs a fresh detail read and explicit acknowledgement, without replay; an uncertain creation requires checking the refreshed playlist list before another create; affected playlist tiles say Review needed and their Add destinations are disabled, with an explanation and direct Review playlists action in the Add dialog; failed duplicate reads and empty additions leave no false lock; other playlists/accounts remain usable and returning to the original account retains its unresolved change; repeated positions select and play independently; if the server cannot identify an occurrence separately, explain unavailable Move/Remove actions while retaining listening and safe edits; changing entries clears unreliable selections and preserves uniquely identified ones |
